units.zh: 貞明六年春正月戊子，以曹州刺史朱漢賓為安州宣威軍節度使；
units.en: On wuzi in the first month of Zhenming 6, Zhu Hanbin, prefect of Cao, was appointed military commissioner of the Xuanwei Army at An.
units.literal: On wuzi, first month of spring of Zhenming 6, Cao prefect Zhu Hanbin was made Anzhou Xuanwei Army military commissioner;

units.zh: 以許州匡國軍節度觀察留後、充散指揮都軍使、檢校太傅王彥章為匡國軍節度使，進封開國侯，軍職如故。
units.en: Wang Yanzhang—Kuangguo observation commissioner at Xu, acting commander of the Scattered Command, and honorary Grand Mentor—was made Kuangguo military commissioner and enfeoffed Marquis Who Opens the State, retaining his army posts.
units.literal: Xu Prefecture Kuangguo Army observation and retention commissioner, acting Scattered Command all-armies commander, honorary Grand Mentor Wang Yanzhang was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner, advanced to Marquis Who Opens the State, military posts unchanged.

units.zh: 二月癸丑，宣州節度使錢傳璟起復，依前檢校太傅、同平章事、宣州節度使，以其丁內艱故也。
units.en: On guichou in the second month Qian Chuanjing of Xuanzhou resumed duty with his former titles of honorary Grand Mentor and co-equal chief minister—he had been observing mourning for his mother.
units.literal: On guichou in the second month, Xuanzhou military commissioner Qian Chuanjing returned to office, continuing as before honorary Grand Mentor, co-equal chief minister, and Xuanzhou military commissioner, because he had been in mourning for his mother within the inner circle.

units.zh: 三月丁亥，以前申州刺史張紹圭為大理卿。
units.en: On dinghai in the third month Zhang Shaogui, former prefect of Shen, became Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: On dinghai in the third month, former Shen prefect Zhang Shaogui was made Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 夏四月己亥，制曰：
units.en: On jihai in the fourth month of summer the throne proclaimed:
units.literal: On jihai in the fourth month of summer, an edict said:

units.zh: 王者愛育萬方，慈養百姓，恨不驅之仁壽，撫以淳和。
units.en: A ruler should cherish all under heaven and care for the people, wishing he could lead them to long life in virtue and govern them in gentle peace.
units.literal: The king loves and nurtures the ten thousand regions, kindly rears the hundred surnames, regretting that he cannot drive them to benevolence and longevity, stroking them with pure harmony.

units.zh: 而炎、黃有戰伐之師，堯、舜有干戈之用，諒不獲已，其猶病諸。
units.en: Even the Yellow and Flame emperors and Yao and Shun resorted to arms when they had no choice, though war grieved them.
units.literal: Yet the Yellow and Flame emperors had armies for battle and attack; Yao and Shun had use for spears and shields—understanding that it could not be avoided, still they were troubled by it.

units.zh: 然則去害除妖，興兵動眾，殺黑龍而濟中土，刑白馬而誓諸侯，終能永逸暫勞，以至同文共軌，古今無異，方冊具存。
units.en: Removing scourges sometimes requires armies: legends tell of slaying the Black Dragon and swearing feudal lords at the white horse—brief hardship for lasting order, one law for all, as histories record.
units.literal: Thus to remove harm and eliminate evil, to raise troops and move the masses—slaying the Black Dragon to save the central land, punishing the white horse to bind the feudal lords—at last one may secure lasting ease through brief toil, reaching shared script and shared track; ancient and modern do not differ, the written registers fully preserve it.

units.zh: 朕以眇末之身，托億兆之上，四海未乂，八年於茲，業業兢兢，日慎一日。
units.en: I, a man of little account set over millions, have ruled eight years while the realm remains unsettled, growing more careful each day.
units.literal: I, with my slight and lowly person, entrusted above the hundred millions, the four seas not yet pacified—eight years to this day—diligent and fearful, daily more cautious.

units.zh: 雖逾山越海，肅慎方來，而召雨征風，蚩尤尚在。
units.en: Distant peoples may submit, yet like Chiyou the storm of rebellion still rages.
units.literal: Though beyond mountains and across seas the Sushen come from afar, yet summoning rain and raising wind, Chiyou is still present.

units.zh: 顧茲殘孽，勞我大邦，將士久於戰征，黎庶疲於力役。
units.en: These rebels drain the empire: troops have fought for years and the people are worn down by labor levies.
units.literal: Looking upon these remnant evils that weary our great state, officers and soldiers long on campaign, the common folk exhausted by corvée.

units.zh: 木牛暫息，則師人有乏爨之憂；
units.en: When supply wagons halt, soldiers fear empty pots;
units.literal: When the wooden ox briefly rests, then the army men have worry of scant cooking;

units.zh: 流馬盡行，則丁壯有無聊之苦。
units.en: when every cart rolls, farmers suffer pointless toil.
units.literal: when the flowing horses all march, then the able-bodied men have the bitterness of idleness.

units.zh: 況青春告謝，朱夏已臨，妨我農時，迫我戎事。
units.en: Spring is over and summer upon us—war now steals the season from the plow.
units.literal: Moreover spring’s green has taken leave and vermilion summer already draws near, obstructing our agricultural season, pressing upon our military affairs.

units.zh: 永言大計，思致小康，宜覃在宥之恩，稍示殷憂之旨。
units.en: Seeking a measure of peace, I mean to grant broad pardon and show how deeply the troubles weigh on me.
units.literal: Ever speaking of the great plan, thinking to bring small peace, it is fitting to spread the grace of amnesty and slightly show the intent of deep concern.

units.zh: 用兵之地，賦役實煩，不有蠲除，何使存濟。
units.en: War zones are crushed by taxes; without relief the people cannot endure.
units.literal: In lands where troops are employed, levies and corvée are truly burdensome; without remission, how may survival be preserved.

units.zh: 除兩京已放免外，應宋、亳、輝、潁、鄆、齊、魏、滑、鄭、濮、沂、密、青、登、萊、淄、陳、許、均、房、襄、鄧、泌、隨、陝、華、雍、晉、絳、懷、汝、商等三十二州，應欠貞明四年終已前夏秋兩稅，並鄆、齊、滑、濮、襄、晉、輝等七州，兼欠貞明四年已前營田課利物色等，並委租庸使逐州據其名額數目矜放。
units.en: Besides remissions already granted in the two capitals, thirty-two prefectures may write off summer and autumn taxes through Zhenming 4; seven more may also write off garrison-field dues before that year—the Rent and Corvée commissioner will verify registers and remit by name.
units.literal: Apart from the two capitals already remitted, for the thirty-two prefectures Song, Bo, Hui, Ying, Yan, Qi, Wei, Hua, Zheng, Pu, Yi, Mi, Qing, Deng, Lai, Zi, Chen, Xu, Jun, Fang, Xiang, Deng, Bi, Sui, Shan, Hua, Yong, Jin, Jiang, Huai, Ru, and Shang—the summer and autumn two taxes owed through the end of Zhenming 4, and for Yan, Qi, Hua, Pu, Xiang, Jin, and Hui—the garrison-field levies and goods owed before Zhenming 4—all are entrusted to the Rent and Corvée commissioner to examine each prefecture’s registered names and amounts and grant compassionate remission.

units.zh: 所在官吏，不得淹停製命，征督下民，致恩澤不及於鄉閭，租稅虛捐於帳籍。
units.en: Magistrates must not stall the edict or squeeze the countryside, lest mercy fail to arrive while books show taxes paid in vain.
units.literal: Local officials must not delay and detain imperial orders, pressing and supervising the people below, causing grace not to reach villages and hamlets and taxes vainly lost on the ledgers.

units.zh: 其有私放遠年債負，生利過倍，自違格條，所在州縣，不在更興征理之限。
units.en: Private lenders who charged more than double on old debts broke the law—officials may not reopen those claims.
units.literal: Where private persons have released debts of distant years and interest exceeds principal in violation of statute, the prefectures and counties where they are located are not within the limit of renewed collection and settlement.

units.zh: 兗州城內，自張守進違背朝廷，結連蕃寇，久勞攻討，頗困生靈，言念傷殘，尋加給復。
units.en: Yanzhou suffered years of siege after Zhang Shoujin’s rebellion; remembering the people’s wounds, the throne will soon restore its tax base.
units.literal: Within Yanzhou city, from the time Zhang Shoujin rebelled against the court and joined barbarian raiders, long laboring attack and suppression, the living folk were greatly distressed; thinking of the wounded and ruined, remission of levies is soon added.

units.zh: 應天下見禁罪人，如犯大辟合抵極刑者，宜示好生，特令減死。
units.en: Those awaiting execution should be shown mercy and their sentences reduced.
units.literal: For criminals now imprisoned throughout the realm who committed capital crimes deserving extreme punishment, it is fitting to show love of life and specially order reduction of death.

units.zh: 除準格律常赦不原外，徒流已下，遞減一等。
units.en: Except where law and ordinary amnesty forbid pardon, reduce penal exile and lesser crimes by one degree.
units.literal: Apart from what statutes and routine amnesties do not pardon, for exile and below reduce one grade in succession.

units.zh: 除降官未經量移者與量移，已量移者便與復資雲。
units.en: Demoted officials not yet reassigned shall be moved; those already moved shall have rank and pay restored.
units.literal: Apart from demoted officials not yet given transfer posts—grant transfer; those already transferred—at once restore rank and salary.

units.zh: 庚子，宗正卿朱守素上言：「請依前朝置匭院，令諫議大夫專判。」
units.en: On gengzi Zhu Shousu, Director of the Imperial Clan, proposed: "Restore the Petition Box Court as in former reigns and put remonstrance grandees in sole charge of it."
units.literal: On gengzi, Director of the Imperial Clan Zhu Shousu memorialized: "I ask that, following earlier dynasties, a Petition Box Court be established and remonstrance and policy grandees assigned to judge it exclusively."

units.zh: 從之，乃以右諫議大夫鄭韜光充知匭使。
units.en: The throne agreed and named Right Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Taoguang Petition-Box commissioner.
units.literal: It was followed; then Right Remonstrance Grandee Zheng Taoguang was made acting Petition-Box commissioner.

units.zh: 乙巳，以右僕射兼門下侍郎、同平章事、監修國史、判度支、開國公敬翔為宏文館大學士、延質庫使、諸道鹽鐵轉運等使，餘如故。
units.en: On yisi Jing Xiang—Right Vice Director, co-equal chief minister, national-history overseer, and Revenue head—became Hongwen grand academician and commissioner of the Extended Treasury and salt-and-iron transport, retaining his other posts.
units.literal: On yisi, Right Vice Director concurrent Gate Department Vice Minister, co-equal chief minister, overseer of compilation of the national history, Revenue overseer, Duke Who Opens the State Jing Xiang was made Hongwen Hall grand academician, Extended Treasury commissioner, and commissioner of salt, iron, and transport for all circuits, the rest unchanged.

units.zh: 以中書侍郎兼刑部尚書、平章事、集賢殿大學士、判戶部事鄭玨為監修國史、判度支。
units.en: Zheng Jue, Secretariat Vice Minister and Households overseer, took over national history and Revenue.
units.literal: Secretariat Vice Minister concurrent Minister of Punishments, chief minister, Hall of Assembled Worthies grand academician, and Households overseer Zheng Jue was made overseer of national history and Revenue.

units.zh: 以中書侍郎、平章事蕭頃為集賢殿大學士、判戶部事。
units.en: Xiao Qing, Vice Minister of the Secretariat and Grand Counselor, became grand academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies and overseer of the Ministry of Households.
units.literal: Secretariat Vice Minister and chief minister Xiao Qing was made Hall of Assembled Worthies grand academician and Households overseer.

units.zh: 以尚書左丞李琪為中書侍郎、平章事。
units.en: Li Qi, Left Secretariat Director, was promoted to Secretariat Vice Minister and chief minister.
units.literal: Left Secretariat Director Li Qi was made Secretariat Vice Minister and chief minister.

units.zh: 丙午，吏部侍朗趙光胤為尚書左丞。
units.en: On bingwu Zhao Guangyin of Personnel became Left Secretariat Director.
units.literal: On bingwu, Personnel Vice Minister Zhao Guangyin was made Left Secretariat Director.

units.zh: 己酉，以河中護國軍節度副大使、知節度事、製置度支解縣池場等使、開府儀同三司、守太保、兼中書令、冀王友謙依前守太保、兼中書令，兼同州節度使，餘如故。
units.en: On jiyou Prince of Ji Zhu Youqian kept his Grand Preceptor and Secretariat Director titles and added Tongzhou military commissioner, retaining his other commissions.
units.literal: On jiyou, Hedong Huguo Army deputy military commissioner, acting military commissioner, commissioner for arranging Revenue and the Jie county salt ponds, Palace-Opening Grand Master of the Same Rank as the Three Dukes, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Ji Zhu Youqian continued as acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Secretariat Director and also Tongzhou military commissioner, the rest unchanged.

units.zh: 癸丑，鄜延節度使兼西面招討接應等使、檢校太保、兼中書令、渤海郡王高萬興進封延安王，賜號匡時定節功臣。
units.en: On guichou Gao Wanxing of Fuyan was made Prince of Yan'an with the merit epithet Merit Lord Who Stabilizes the Age and Sets the Seasons.
units.literal: On guichou, Fuyan military commissioner concurrent Western Pacification and liaison commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Bohai Gao Wanxing was advanced to Prince of Yan'an and granted the merit title Merit Lord Who Stabilizes the Age and Sets the Seasons.

units.zh: 前衡州長史劉騭進所撰《地理手鏡》十卷。
units.en: Liu Chi, former senior adjutant of Hengzhou, submitted ten fascicles of his 《Geographic Hand Mirror》.
units.literal: Former Hengzhou senior adjutant Liu Chi presented his compiled ten fascicles of 《Geographic Hand Mirror》.

units.zh: 己未，以租庸判官、尚書工部郎中張銳為戶部郎中，充崇政院學士。
units.en: On jiwei Zhang Rui, Rent and Corvée judge, became Households bureau director and Chongzheng Hall academician.
units.literal: On jiwei, Rent and Corvée judge and Ministry of Works bureau director Zhang Rui was made Households bureau director and appointed Chongzheng Hall academician.

units.zh: 辛酉，以前吏部侍郎盧協為禮部侍郎。
units.en: On xinyou Lu Xie, former Personnel Vice Minister, was appointed Rites Vice Minister.
units.literal: On xinyou, former Personnel Vice Minister Lu Xie was made Rites Vice Minister.

units.zh: 五月乙丑，故左衛上將軍齊奉國贈太傅。
units.en: On yichou in the fifth month the late Qi Fengguo, Left Guard senior general, was posthumously honored as Grand Mentor.
units.literal: On yichou in the fifth month, the late Left Guard senior general Qi Fengguo was posthumously made Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 詔曰：「應文武朝官，或有替罷多年，漂流在外者，宜令中書門下量才除授，勿使棲遲。
units.en: An edict declared: "Civil and military officials long unemployed and wandering should be given posts suited to their talent, lest they languish.
units.literal: An edict said: "For civil and military court officials, some replaced and dismissed many years who drift outside, it is fitting to order the Secretariat to measure talent and appoint, and not let them linger in delay.

units.zh: 或有進士策名、累年未釋褐者，與初任一官；
units.en: Jinshi who never received their first appointment shall receive one office;
units.literal: Some who passed the jinshi examination and for years have not received the initial robe—grant a first office;

units.zh: 已釋褐者，依前資敘用。」
units.en: those already robed shall be ranked by prior merit."
units.literal: those who already received the robe—employ according to former qualification."

units.zh: 乙酉，升宋州為大都督府，其餘廢大都督府額。
units.en: On yiyou Songzhou became a Superior Metropolitan Prefecture while other such designations were abolished.
units.literal: On yiyou, Songzhou was elevated to Superior Metropolitan Prefecture; the rest abolished Superior Metropolitan Prefecture designations.

units.zh: 六月，遣兗州節度使劉鄩、華州節度使尹皓、崇州節度使溫昭圖、莊宅使段凝領軍攻同州。
units.en: In the sixth month Liu Yan of Yan, Yin Hao of Hua, Wen Zhaotu of Chong, and Duan Ning of the Manor Estates marched on Tongzhou.
units.literal: In the sixth month, Yanzhou military commissioner Liu Yan, Huazhou military commissioner Yin Hao, Chongzhou military commissioner Wen Zhaotu, and Manor Estates commissioner Duan Ning led armies to attack Tongzhou.

units.zh: 先是，河中朱友謙襲陷同州，節度使程全暉單騎奔京師。
units.en: Zhu Youqian of Hedong had seized Tongzhou and Cheng Quanhui, its commissioner, rode alone to the capital.
units.literal: Earlier, Zhu Youqian of Hedong had raided and taken Tongzhou; military commissioner Cheng Quanhui fled alone on horseback to the capital.

units.zh: 友謙以其子令德為同州留後，表求節旄，不允；
units.en: Youqian installed his son Lingde as acting commissioner and asked for the seal; the court refused;
units.literal: Youqian made his son Lingde Tongzhou retention commissioner and memorialized for the military commission; it was not granted;

units.zh: 既而帝慮友謙怨望，遂命兼鎮同州，製命將下而友謙已叛，遣使求援於晉，故命將討之。
units.en: Fearing resentment, the Emperor then named Youqian concurrent commissioner of Tong—but before the edict arrived Youqian rebelled and sought Jin’s aid, and punitive armies were dispatched.
units.literal: then the Emperor, fearing Youqian’s resentment, ordered him to hold Tongzhou concurrently; the edict was about to issue when Youqian had already rebelled, sending envoys to seek aid from Jin—hence generals were ordered to punish him.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，以供奉官郎公遠充契丹歡好使。
units.en: On gengyin in the ninth month Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was sent as envoy of goodwill to the Khitan.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month, Palace Attendant Lang Gongyuan was made Khitan Goodwill envoy.

units.zh: 晉王遣都將李嗣昭、李存審、王建及率師來援同州，戰於城下。
units.en: The Prince of Jin sent Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji to relieve Tongzhou and battle was joined under the walls.
units.literal: The Prince of Jin sent commanders Li Sizhao, Li Cunshen, and Wang Jianji with troops to relieve Tongzhou; they fought below the walls.

units.zh: 我師敗績，諸將以餘眾退保華州羅文寨。
units.en: Our forces were beaten; the generals fell back with survivors to Luowen Stockade in Hua.
units.literal: Our army suffered defeat; the generals with the remaining troops withdrew to hold Huazhou’s Luowen Stockade.

units.zh: 冬十月，陳州妖賊毋乙、董乙伏誅。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter the Chenzhou rebels Wu Yi and Dong Yi were put to death.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, the Chenzhou demonic bandits Wu Yi and Dong Yi were executed.

units.zh: 陳州裏俗之人，喜習左道，依浮屠氏之教，自立一宗，號曰「上乘」。
units.en: Chenzhou commoners dabbled in heterodox cults, aping Buddhism while founding a sect called the "Supreme Vehicle."
units.literal: The vulgar folk of Chenzhou liked to practice heterodox ways, following the Buddha’s teaching yet establishing a separate sect themselves, called "Supreme Vehicle."

units.zh: 不食葷茹，誘化庸民，揉雜淫穢，宵聚晝散。
units.en: They abstained from meat, drew in the ignorant, mixed obscenity with worship, and met by night.
units.literal: They did not eat meat or pungent plants, seduced and transformed the simple folk, mingling lewd filth, gathering at night and dispersing by day.

units.zh: 州縣因循，遂致滋蔓。
units.en: Local officials looked the other way until the movement spread unchecked.
units.literal: Prefectures and counties followed along and thus it spread.

units.zh: 時刺史惠王友能恃戚藩之寵，動多不法，故奸慝之徒，望風影附。
units.en: Prefect Prince of Hui You Neng, favored as imperial kin, broke the law at will, and villains flocked to him.
units.literal: At the time the prefect, Prince of Hui You Neng, relied on favor as a maternal kinsman of the imperial clan and often acted unlawfully, so evil men attached to him like shadows in the wind.

units.zh: 毋乙數輩，漸及千人，攻掠鄉社，長吏不能詰。
units.en: Wu Yi’s band grew to a thousand, pillaging the countryside while magistrates dared not act.
units.literal: Wu Yi and several companions gradually reached a thousand men, raiding villages and communities; the chief officials could not interrogate them.

units.zh: 是歲秋，其眾益盛，南通淮夷，朝廷累發州兵討捕，反為賊所敗。
units.en: By autumn they had swelled, linked with Huai tribes, and defeated every prefectural force the court sent.
units.literal: That autumn their masses grew still greater, reaching south to the Huai barbarians; the court repeatedly sent prefectural troops to pursue and capture, yet was in turn defeated by the bandits.

units.zh: 陳、潁、蔡三州，大被其毒。
units.en: Chen, Ying, and Cai bore the worst of their ravages.
units.literal: Chen, Ying, and Cai—the three prefectures—suffered greatly from their poison.

units.zh: 群賊乃立毋乙為天子，其餘豪首，各有樹置。
units.en: They proclaimed Wu Yi emperor and installed their other leaders in offices.
units.literal: The bandit host then set up Wu Yi as Son of Heaven; the rest of the chieftains each had appointments made.

units.zh: 至是，發禁軍及數郡兵合勢追擊，賊潰，生擒毋乙等首領八十餘人，械送闕下，並斬於都市。
units.en: Imperial Guards and allied prefectural troops then crushed them, took eighty-odd chiefs including Wu Yi, and beheaded them in the capital market.
units.literal: At this time the court sent the Imperial Guard and troops of several prefectures in combined pursuit; the bandits collapsed, and more than eighty leaders including Wu Yi were captured alive, sent in fetters to the capital, and all beheaded in the marketplace.

units.zh: 龍德元年春正月癸巳，詔諸道入奏判官，宜令御史台點檢，合從正衙退後，便於中書門下公參辭謝。
units.en: On guisi in the first month of Longde 1 an edict required the Censorate to inspect circuit memorial adjudicators, who after main court audience should offer respects at the Secretariat and Chancellery.
units.literal: On guisi in the first month of spring of Longde 1, an edict ordered that memorial-report adjudicators from all circuits should be inspected by the Censorate; after withdrawing from the main court audience they should pay public respects and offer thanks at the Secretariat and Chancellery.

units.zh: 如有違越，具名銜聞奏。
units.en: Violations were to be memorialized by name.
units.literal: If there were violations, report them by name in memorial.

units.zh: 應麵賜章服，仍令閣門使取本官狀申中書門下，受敕牒後，方可結入新銜。
units.en: Officials granted court robes had to have Palace Gate commissioners submit their appointment records to the Secretariat and Chancellery, and new titles could be entered only after edict slips were received.
units.literal: For those granted robes and insignia in audience, Palace Gate commissioners should obtain their original appointment documents and submit them to the Secretariat and Chancellery; only after receiving edict slips could new titles be formally entered.

units.zh: 甲辰，以河東道行營西面應接使、前靜勝軍節度、崇裕等州觀察處置等使、特進、檢校太尉、同平章事溫昭圖為匡國軍節度、陳許蔡等州觀察處置等使。
units.en: On jiachen Wen Zhaotu was made Kuangguo military commissioner and observation commissioner of Chen, Xu, and Cai.
units.literal: On jiachen Wen Zhaotu—Hedong circuit Western Campaign liaison commissioner, former Jingsheng Army military commissioner and Chongyu and other prefectures observation and disposition commissioner, Specially Advanced, honorary Grand Commandant, and co-equal chief minister—was made Kuangguo Army military commissioner and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation and disposition commissioner.

units.zh: 以北面行營副招討使、匡國軍節度、陳許蔡等州觀察處置等使、光祿大夫、檢校太傅王彥章為宣義軍節度副大使，知節度事，鄭、滑、濮等州觀察處置等使，依前北面副招討使。
units.en: Wang Yanzhang was named deputy Xuanyi military commissioner over Zheng, Hua, and Pu while keeping his Northern Campaign deputy Pacification post.
units.literal: Northern Campaign deputy Pacification commissioner, Kuangguo Army military commissioner, and Chen, Xu, and Cai observation commissioner Wang Yanzhang, Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and honorary Grand Mentor, was made deputy military commissioner of the Xuanyi Army, acting commissioner, and observation commissioner of Zheng, Hua, and Pu, retaining his former Northern deputy Pacification post.

units.zh: 二月己未，以權知靜勝軍節度觀察留後、前汝州防禦使華溫琪為靜勝軍節度觀察留後，依前檢校太傅。
units.en: On jiwei in the second month Hua Wenqi became Jingsheng observation commissioner with his former honorary Grand Mentor title.
units.literal: On jiwei in the second month, acting Jingsheng Army observation and retention commissioner and former Ruzhou defense commissioner Hua Wenqi was made Jingsheng observation and retention commissioner, continuing as before honorary Grand Mentor.

units.zh: 丙寅，以荊南節度使、檢校太師、兼中書令、渤海郡王高季昌為守中書令，依前荊南節度使。
units.en: On bingyin Gao Jichang of Jingnan was named acting Secretariat Director while remaining Jingnan commissioner.
units.literal: On bingyin, Jingnan military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Prince of Bohai Gao Jichang was made acting Secretariat Director, continuing as Jingnan military commissioner.

units.zh: 庚午，以晉州建寧軍節度觀察留後劉玘為晉州節度使、檢校太保。
units.en: On gengwu Liu Qi became Jinzhou military commissioner and honorary Grand Preceptor.
units.literal: On gengwu, Jinzhou Jianning Army observation and retention commissioner Liu Qi was made Jinzhou military commissioner and honorary Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 壬申，史館上言：「伏見北齊文士魏收著《後魏書》，於時自魏太武之初，至於北齊，書不獲就，乃大征百官家傳，刊總斟酌，隨條甄舉，搜訪遺亡，數年之間，勒為一代典籍，編在北史，固非虛言。
units.en: On renshen the Historiography Office memorialized: "Citing Wei Shou’s 《History of Later Wei》, unable to finish from Taiwu to Northern Qi, he gathered officials’ genealogies, sifted and recovered lost material, and within years produced a classic now preserved in the Northern History.
units.literal: On renshen the Historiography Office memorialized: "We humbly see the Northern Qi man of letters Wei Shou compile the 《History of Later Wei》; at the time from the beginning of Northern Wei Emperor Taiwu down to Northern Qi the book could not be completed, so they greatly summoned the family genealogies of the hundred officials, collated and weighed them, selected item by item, searched out what was lost—within several years it was carved into the canon of one age, compiled in the Northern History; this is truly no empty saying.

units.zh: 臣今請明下製，敕內外百官及前資士子、帝戚勳家，並各納家傳，具述父祖事行源流及才術德業灼然可考者，並纂述送史館。
units.en: We ask an edict requiring officials, scholars, kin, and meritorious houses to submit genealogies of verifiable ancestors and send compiled accounts to the Historiography Office.
units.literal: Your servant now asks that an edict be clearly issued commanding inner and outer officials, former qualified scholars, imperial kin, and meritorious families each to submit family genealogies fully narrating fathers’ and grandfathers’ conduct, origins, and clearly verifiable talent, arts, virtue, and achievement, all compiled and sent to the Historiography Office.

units.zh: 如記得前朝會昌已後公私，亦任抄錄送官，皆須直書，不用文藻。
units.en: Memories of public affairs since Huichang may be copied in plain prose without ornament.
units.literal: If they recall public and private matters after Huichang of the prior dynasty, they may also copy and send them to the authorities—all must be straight writing, without literary ornament.

units.zh: 兼以兵火之後，簡牘罕存，應內外臣僚，曾有奏行公事，關涉製置，或討論沿革，或章疏文詞，有可采者，並許編錄送納。
units.en: Moreover, after the fires of war, documents rarely survive. Officials inside and outside the court who once memorialized on public business touching institutions, discussed precedents and changes, or wrote memorial language worth preserving may all compile and submit it.
units.literal: Moreover after the fires of war documents rarely survive; inner and outer officials who once memorialized on business touching institutions, discussing evolution, or memorial language worth adopting—all may compile and send in.

units.zh: 候史館修撰之日，考其所上公事，與中書門下文案事相符會，或格言正辭詢訪不謬者，並與編載。
units.en: At compilation time their submissions will be checked against Secretariat files; verified material and sound phrases will enter the history.
units.literal: When the Historiography Office day of compilation arrives, examine the public business they submit against Secretariat records, or upright words and correct phrases found on inquiry not in error—all shall be compiled together.

units.zh: 所冀忠臣名士，共流家國之耿光；
units.en: Thus loyal ministers and eminent men may shine in the annals of the realm;
units.literal: What is hoped is that loyal ministers and famous scholars together may stream the bright glory of state and family;

units.zh: 孝子順孫，獲記祖先之丕烈。
units.en: and filial descendants may preserve their forebears’ fame.
units.literal: filial sons and obedient grandsons may obtain record of ancestors’ great achievements.

units.zh: 而且周德見乎殷紀，舜典存乎禹功，非唯十世可知，庶成一朝大典。
units.en: As Zhou virtue appears in Yin records and Shun’s canon in Yu’s deeds, ten generations may be known and our dynasty’s great history completed.
units.literal: Moreover Zhou virtue appears in Yin annals; Shun’s canon rests in Yu’s achievement—not only may ten generations be known, but perhaps one dynasty’s great canon may be completed.

units.zh: 臣叨庸委任，獲領監修，將贖素食，輒幹元覽。」
units.en: Humbly overseeing compilation, I venture this plea before your majesty."
units.literal: Your servant, unworthily entrusted, has obtained charge of compilation oversight; wishing to repay the debt of drawing an unearned salary, I rashly trouble the imperial gaze."

units.zh: 詔從之。
units.en: The throne approved.
units.literal: The edict followed it.

units.zh: 鹽鐵轉運使敬翔奏：「請於雍州、河陽、徐州三處重置場院稅茶。」
units.en: Jing Xiang, Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner, memorialized: "Please restore tea taxes at market yards in Yong, Heyang, and Xu."
units.literal: Salt and Iron Transport Commissioner Jing Xiang memorialized: "I ask that at Yongzhou, Heyang, and Xuzhou three places the market-yard tea tax be re-established."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The request was granted.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 己卯，禮部尚書、充西都副留守兼判尚書省事崔沂奏：「西京都省，凡有公事奏聞，常須借印施行，伏請鑄尚事省分司印一面。」
units.en: On jimao Cui Yi of Rites memorialized: "The Western Capital directorate must borrow seals for public business; please cast a branch seal for the directorate office."
units.literal: On jimao, Rites Minister, acting Western Capital deputy defender and acting overseer of the Secretariat office Cui Yi memorialized: "In the Western Capital directorate, whenever public business is memorialized, seals must usually be borrowed to execute; I humbly ask that one branch seal of the Directorate office be cast."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: The throne agreed.
units.literal: It was followed.

units.zh: 是月，鎮州大將王德明殺其帥王熔，自稱留後，遣使來求援。
units.en: That month Wang Deming of Zhenzhou murdered Wang Rong, declared himself acting commissioner, and asked for help.
units.literal: That month, Zhenzhou great general Wang Deming killed his commander Wang Rong, styled himself retention commissioner, and sent envoys to seek aid.

units.zh: 宰臣敬翔請許之，租庸使趙岩等以為不可，乃止。
units.en: Jing Xiang favored acceptance; Zhao Yan and others refused, and the court declined.
units.literal: Chief minister Jing Xiang asked to grant it; Rent and Corvée commissioner Zhao Yan and others held it impossible, and it stopped.

units.zh: 三月丁亥朔，祠部員外郎李樞上言：「請禁天下私度僧尼，及不許妄求師號紫衣。
units.en: On dinghai, first of the third month, Li Shu of Sacrificial Affairs proposed: "Ban private ordinations throughout the realm and forbid unauthorized purple robes and master titles.
units.literal: On dinghai, first day of the third month, Sacrificial Affairs outer-office director Li Shu memorialized: "I ask to forbid private ordination of monks and nuns throughout the realm, and not to allow reckless seeking of master titles and purple robes.

units.zh: 如願出家受戒者，皆須赴闕比試藝業施行，願歸俗者一聽自便。」
units.en: Candidates must pass court examination before ordination; those returning to lay life may do so freely."
units.literal: If they wish to leave the world and receive precepts, all must come to court to compete in arts and skill before ordination; those wishing to return to the laity—hear and let them as they please."

units.zh: 詔曰：「兩都左右街賜紫衣及師號僧，委功德使具名聞奏。
units.en: An edict ruled: "Purple robes and master titles on both capitals’ monastic avenues shall be listed by the Merit commissioner.
units.literal: An edict said: "Monks of the two capitals’ left and right streets granted purple robes and master titles—entrust the Merit commissioner to list names and report.

units.zh: 今後有闕，方得奏薦，仍須道行精至，夏臘高深，方得補填。
units.en: Vacancies alone may be filled, and only monks of proven conduct and long discipline.
units.literal: Hereafter when there is a vacancy, only then may memorial recommendation be made; still they must be refined in the Way, of deep summer discipline and years, before filling the post.

units.zh: 每遇明聖節，兩街各許官壇度七人。
units.en: At each Bright Sage Festival each avenue may ordain seven monks at the state altar.
units.literal: Whenever the Bright Sage Festival occurs, each street may ordain seven at the official altar.

units.zh: 諸道如要度僧，亦仰就京官壇，仍令祠部給牒。
units.en: Provincial ordinations must use the capital altar, with certificates from Sacrificial Affairs.
units.literal: If circuits wish to ordain monks, they too shall rely on the capital’s official altar, and the Sacrificial Affairs office shall issue certificates.

units.zh: 今後隻兩街置僧錄，道錄僧正並廢。」
units.en: Only the two capitals’ avenues will keep monastic registrars; provincial registrars are abolished."
units.literal: Hereafter only the two streets shall have monastic registrars; Daoist registrars and monastic rectifiers are abolished."

units.zh: 己丑，以前兵部郎中杜光乂為左諫議大夫致仕。
units.en: On jichou Du Guangyi, former War bureau director, retired as Left Remonstrance Grandee.
units.literal: On jichou, former Ministry of War bureau director Du Guangyi was made Left Remonstrance Grandee retired.

units.zh: 壬寅，改襄州鄢縣為沿夏縣，亳州焦夷縣為夷父縣，密州漢諸縣為膠源縣，從中書舍人馬縞請也。
units.en: On renyin three counties were renamed at Secretariat Drafter Ma Gao’s request: Yan to Yanxia, Jiaoyi to Yifu, Hanzhu to Jiaoyuan.
units.literal: On renyin, Yan county of Xiangzhou was changed to Yanxia county, Jiaoyi county of Bozhou to Yifu county, and Hanzhu county of Mizhou to Jiaoyuan county, following Secretariat Drafter Ma Gao’s request.

units.zh: 夏四月，陳州刺史惠王友能反，舉兵向闕。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer Prince of Hui You Neng of Chenzhou rebelled and marched on the capital.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Chenzhou prefect Prince of Hui You Neng rebelled and raised troops toward the palace.

units.zh: 帝命將出師逆擊，敗之。
units.en: The Emperor sent armies to meet them and won.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered generals to take the field and strike in reverse, defeating them.

units.zh: 友能走保陳州，詔張漢傑率兵進討。
units.en: You Neng shut himself in Chenzhou; Zhang Hanjie was ordered to besiege him.
units.literal: You Neng fled to hold Chenzhou; an edict ordered Zhang Hanjie to lead troops forward to attack.

units.zh: 敕開封府太康、襄邑、雍丘三縣，遭陳州賊軍奔衝，其夏稅隻據見苗輸納。
units.en: Kaifeng’s Taikang, Xiangyi, and Yongqiu were told to levy summer tax only on grain still standing after Chen rebels swept through.
units.literal: An edict to Kaifeng prefecture’s Taikang, Xiangyi, and Yongqiu three counties: where Chenzhou rebel armies rushed through, summer tax shall be paid only according to standing grain in the field.

units.zh: 五月丙戌朔，製曰：
units.en: On bingxu, first of the fifth month, the throne proclaimed:
units.literal: On bingxu, first day of the fifth month, an edict said:

units.zh: 朕聞惟辟動天，惟聖時憲，故君為善則天降之以福，為不善則降之以災。
units.en: Heaven answers the ruler’s virtue with blessing and his faults with disaster—such is the way of the sage-kings.
units.literal: I have heard that only the sovereign moves Heaven and only the sage is the age’s model; thus when the ruler does good Heaven sends blessing down, when he does evil Heaven sends calamity down.

units.zh: 朕以眇末之身，托於王公之上，不能荷先帝艱難之運，所以致蒼生塗炭之危。
units.en: I, unworthy upon the throne, failed to sustain my father’s hard-won realm and brought the people to ruin.
units.literal: I, with my slight and lowly person, entrusted above kings and dukes, unable to bear the former emperor’s difficult fortune—therefore bringing the dark peril of the living folk smeared in dust.

units.zh: 兵革薦興，災害仍集，內省厥咎，蓋由朕躬。
units.en: War and calamity persist; the fault is mine alone.
units.literal: Arms and armor rise again and again; disasters still gather; inwardly examining the fault, it lies in my person.

units.zh: 故北有邊裔狡逞之師，西有蒲、同亂常之旅，連年戰伐，積歲轉輸，虔劉我士民，侵據我郡邑。
units.en: Northern barbarians raid; Pu and Tong rebel in the west—years of war have slaughtered our people and lost our towns.
units.literal: Thus in the north are border tribes’ crafty and overbearing armies; in the west are Pu and Tong’s troops that disturb the norm—year after year campaigning, year after year transport, slaughtering and harrying our officers and people, invading and seizing our prefectures and counties.

units.zh: 師無宿飽之饋，家無擔石之儲，而又水潦為災，蟲蝗作沴，戒譴作於上，怨谘聞於下。
units.en: Troops go hungry, homes empty; flood and locust follow, heaven warns and the people murmur.
units.literal: Armies lack overnight-full provisions; households lack a stone’s storage; moreover floods become disaster, locusts become pestilence—warning and reprimand arise above, resentment and complaint are heard below.

units.zh: 而況骨肉之內，竊弄干戈，畿甸之中，輒為陵暴。
units.en: Even kin have taken up arms; the capital itself has been terrorized.
units.literal: Moreover within flesh and bone they secretly play with weapons; within the capital districts they rashly commit outrage.

units.zh: 但責躬而罪己，敢怨天以尤人。
units.en: I blame only myself, not Heaven or my subjects.
units.literal: I only blame my person and charge myself; I dare not blame Heaven and fault others.

units.zh: 蓋朕無德以事上玄，無功以及兆庶，不便於時者未能去，有益於民者未能行。
units.en: I have lacked virtue before heaven and merit for the people, failing to end what harms the age or do what helps it.
units.literal: For I lack virtue to serve the Supreme Mystery, lack achievement to reach the hundred millions—what is inconvenient to the age I have been unable to remove, what benefits the people I have been unable to enact.

units.zh: 處事昧於酌中，發令乖於至當，招致災患，引翼禍殃。
units.en: My judgments have missed the mark and my edicts gone awry, inviting catastrophe.
units.literal: In handling affairs I have been obscure at the mean; in issuing orders I have missed what is most fitting—attracting disaster and calamity, drawing winged misfortune.

units.zh: 罪在朕躬，不敢自赦。
units.en: The fault is mine alone; I claim no exemption.
units.literal: The guilt lies in my person; I dare not pardon myself.

units.zh: 夙夜是懼，寢食靡寧，將勵己以息災，爰布澤而從欲。
units.en: I lie awake in dread and will reform myself, granting mercy to ease the realm.
units.literal: Early and late I am in fear; sleep and food are not at peace; I will encourage myself to quell disaster, and spread grace to follow desire.

units.zh: 今以薰風方扇，旭日初升，朔既視於正陽，曆宜更於嘉號。
units.en: As summer begins and a new reign day dawns, the era name must change.
units.literal: Now with warm wind fanning and the bright sun first rising, the new moon has been viewed at the proper yang, the calendar should be changed to an auspicious designation.

units.zh: 庶惟新之令，敷華夏以同歡；
units.en: Let renewal reach all the land in shared joy.
units.literal: May the order of renewal spread so Hua and Xia rejoice together;

units.zh: 期克念之心，與皇王而合道。
units.en: And may my resolve match the way of the sage-kings.
units.literal: may the heart of overcoming thought align with emperors and kings in the Way.

units.zh: 其貞明七年，宜改為龍德元年，應天下見禁罪人，除大辟罪外，遞減一等。
units.en: The seventh year of Zhenming becomes Longde 1; all prisoners except capital cases are reduced one degree.
units.literal: Zhenming 7 shall be changed to Longde 1; for criminals now imprisoned throughout the realm, apart from capital crimes reduce one grade in succession.

units.zh: 德音到後，三日內疏理訖奏。
units.en: Courts must finish review within three days of the amnesty.
units.literal: After the grace edict arrives, within three days complete review and memorialize.

units.zh: 應欠貞明三年、四年諸色殘欠，五年、六年夏稅殘稅，並放。
units.en: Tax arrears from Zhenming 3 through 6 are forgiven.
units.literal: Outstanding arrears of Zhenming 3 and 4 in all categories, and residual summer taxes of years 5 and 6—all remitted.

units.zh: 侍衛親軍及諸道行營將士等第頒賜優賞，已從別敕處分。
units.en: Guards and campaign troops received graded bonuses by separate edict.
units.literal: Imperial Guard and all circuit campaign officers and soldiers received graded bestowal of generous rewards—already handled by separate edict.

units.zh: 左降官與量移，已經量移者與復資。
units.en: Demoted officials are reassigned; the reassigned regain rank.
units.literal: Demoted officials receive transfer; those already transferred receive restoration of rank.

units.zh: 長流人各移近地，已經移者許歸鄉里，前資朝官，寄寓遠方，仰長吏津置赴闕。
units.en: Exiles move closer or home; displaced officials shall be escorted to the capital.
units.literal: Those exiled to distant places each move nearer; those already moved may return home; former court officials dwelling far away—look to chief officials for passage to court.

units.zh: 內外文武常參官、節度使、留後、刺史、父母亡歿者並與封贈。
units.en: All ranking officials and commissioners may enfeoff deceased parents.
units.literal: Inner and outer civil and military regular attendees, military commissioners, retention commissioners, and prefects whose parents have died—all receive posthumous enfeoffment.

units.zh: 公私債負，納利及一倍已上者，不得利上生利。
units.en: Lenders who have recovered principal may not charge interest on interest.
units.literal: For public and private debts, where interest paid has reached principal and more, interest upon interest is not permitted.

units.zh: 先經陣歿將校，各與追贈雲。
units.en: Officers killed in action receive posthumous honors.
units.literal: Former commanders who fell in battle—each receive posthumous advancement.

units.zh: 以宣和庫使、守右領衛將軍李嚴權知兗州軍州事。
units.en: Li Yan of the Xuanhe Treasury was given acting command of Yanzhou.
units.literal: Xuanhe Treasury commissioner and acting Right Forest-Unicorn general Li Yan was made acting Yanzhou military and prefectural commissioner.

units.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「郊禋大禮，舊有渥恩，御殿改元，比無賞給。
units.en: On dinghai an edict said: "Suburban sacrifices brought largesse, but this era change had no rewards.
units.literal: On dinghai, an edict said: "Suburban and border sacrifices, the old have generous grace; changing the era at the imperial hall, by comparison there was no reward grant.

units.zh: 今則不循舊例，別示特恩。
units.en: The throne therefore granted a special bounty.
units.literal: Now we do not follow the old example but separately show special grace.

units.zh: 其行營將士賞賚已給付本家，宜令招討使霍彥威、副招討使王彥章、陳州行營都指揮使張漢傑曉示諸軍知委。」
units.en: Campaign bonuses sent to soldiers’ families should be announced by Huo Yanwei, Wang Yanzhang, and Zhang Hanjie."
units.literal: Campaign soldiers’ rewards already paid to their families—the Pacification commissioner Huo Yanwei, deputy Pacification commissioner Wang Yanzhang, and Chenzhou campaign commander-in-chief Zhang Hanjie should announce to all armies for their knowledge."

units.zh: 是月，兗州節度使、充河東道行營都招討使劉鄩卒。
units.en: That month Liu Yan, Yanzhou commissioner and Hedong campaign commander, died.
units.literal: That month, Yanzhou military commissioner and Hedong circuit campaign commander-in-chief Liu Yan died.

units.zh: 六月己亥，以都檢點諸司法物使、檢校司徒、行左驍衛大將軍李肅為右威衛上將軍。
units.en: On jihai in the sixth month Li Su became Right Majestic Guard senior general.
units.literal: On jihai in the sixth month, General Inspector of all-circuit legal goods and honorary Minister over the Masses, acting Left Valiant Cavalry senior general Li Su was made Right Majestic Guard senior general.

units.zh: 秋七月，陳州朱友能降。
units.en: In the seventh month of autumn Zhu You Neng of Chenzhou surrendered.
units.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Chenzhou Zhu You Neng surrendered.

units.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「朕君臨四海，子育兆民，惟持不黨之心，庶葉無私之運。
units.en: On gengzi the Emperor declared: "I rule all and seek impartial justice.
units.literal: On gengzi, an edict said: "I rule the four seas and nurture the hundred millions, holding only an unbiased heart, hoping to fulfill an unselfish destiny.

units.zh: 其有齒予戚屬，雖深敦敘之情。
units.en: Though kinship binds me to kinsmen,
units.literal: For those who are kin by tooth and gift, though deep is the feeling of kinship and ordering.

units.zh: 幹我國經，難固含宏之旨。
units.en: those who break the law cannot be indulged.
units.literal: if they disturb our state’s laws, it is hard to fix the intent of forbearance.

units.zh: 須遵常憲，以示至公。
units.en: Statute must prevail over favor.
units.literal: They must follow the regular statutes to show utmost fairness.

units.zh: 特進、檢校太傅、使持節陳州刺史、兼御史大夫、上柱國、食邑三千戶惠王友能，列爵為王，頒條治郡，受元戎之寄任，處千里之封疆。
units.en: Prince of Hui You Neng of Chen—a prince with three thousand households, entrusted with a thousand li.
units.literal: Specially advanced, honorary Grand Mentor, holding staff as Chenzhou military commissioner, concurrent Censor-in-chief, Pillar of State, fief of three thousand households, Prince of Hui You Neng—enfeoffed prince, issued regulations governing the prefecture, entrusted with the main army’s commission, placed over a thousand-li territory.

units.zh: 就進官資，巳登崇貴，時加錫賚，以表優隆。
units.en: He had been raised to the highest honors and showered with gifts.
units.literal: Upon advancing in office and rank he already ascended to lofty honor; from time to time gifts were added to show special elevation.

units.zh: 宜切知恩，合思盡節，撫俗當申於仁政，佐時期效於忠規。
units.en: He should have repaid favor with loyalty and governed humanely.
units.literal: He ought deeply to know grace and think to exhaust loyalty, soothing the folk with humane government and in assisting the age expecting to effect loyal counsel.

units.zh: 而狎彼小人，納其邪說，忽稱兵而向闕，敢越境以殘民，侵犯郊畿，驚撓輦轂，遠邇咸嫉，謀畫交陳。
units.en: Instead he listened to villains, marched on the capital, ravaged the people, and terrified the court.
units.literal: Yet he fraternized with petty men and took in their evil counsel; suddenly he called up troops toward the palace, dared cross borders to harm the people, invaded the suburbs, alarmed the imperial carriage—near and far alike resented it, plans and memorials piled up.

units.zh: 及興問罪之師，旋驗知非之狀，瀝懇繼陳於章表，束身願赴於闕庭，備述艱危，覬加寬恕。
units.en: Defeated, he begged forgiveness and offered to surrender at court.
units.literal: When troops to question his crime were raised, he soon proved knowledge of wrong in his conduct; earnest pleas followed in memorials, binding himself willing to come to the palace court, fully narrating peril, hoping for added forgiveness.

units.zh: 朕得不自為屈己，姑務安仁，特施貸法之恩，蓋舉議親之律。
units.en: I humbled myself and showed kin mercy under commuted sentence.
units.literal: I could not but humble myself and for the moment seek to settle benevolence, specially applying the grace of commuted law, broadly raising the statute of favoring kin.

units.zh: 詢於事體，抑有朝章，止行退責之文，用塞眾多之論。
units.en: Yet statute required punishment; demotion alone answers the critics.
units.literal: Inquiring into the matter’s substance, there is still court statute; only the writing of demotion is executed to block the many discussions.

units.zh: 可降封房陵侯。
units.en: He is demoted to Marquis of Fangling.
units.literal: He may be demoted and enfeoffed Marquis of Fangling.

units.zh: 於戲！
units.en: Ah!
units.literal: Alas!

units.zh: 君臣之禮，彼有不恭；
units.en: Between ruler and subject he showed no respect;
units.literal: In the rite of ruler and minister, he was not respectful;

units.zh: 伯仲之恩，予垂立愛。
units.en: yet as brother I still show love.
units.literal: in elder and younger brother’s grace, I still set up love.

units.zh: 顧茲輕典，豈稱群情，凡在臣僚，當體朕意。」
units.en: This light sentence may not satisfy opinion; officials should understand my intent."
units.literal: Looking upon this light code, how can it match the crowd’s feeling—every official should embody my intent."

units.zh: 甲辰，制以特進、檢校太傅、衡王友諒可封嗣廣王。
units.en: On jiachen Prince of Heng Zhu Youliang was enfeoffed as succeeding Prince of Guang.
units.literal: On jiachen, an edict enfeoffed Specially Advanced, honorary Grand Mentor, Prince of Heng Zhu Youliang as succeeding Prince of Guang.

units.zh: 冬十月，北面招討使戴思遠攻德勝寨之北城，晉人來援，思遠敗於戚城。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Dai Siyuan attacked Desheng’s north wall; Jin relief defeated him at Qi.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Northern Pacification commissioner Dai Siyuan attacked the northern city of Desheng Stockade; Jin men came to relieve; Siyuan was defeated at Qi city.

units.zh: 龍德二年春正月，戴思遠率師襲魏州。
units.en: In the first month of Longde 2 Dai Siyuan raided Weizhou.
units.literal: In the first month of spring of Longde 2, Dai Siyuan led troops to raid Weizhou.

units.zh: 時晉王方攻鎮州，故思遠乘虛以襲之，陷成安，而思遠遂急攻德勝北城，晉將李存審極力拒守。
units.en: While the Prince of Jin besieged Zhenzhou, Siyuan took Cheng'an and stormed Desheng’s north wall; Li Cunshen held firm.
units.literal: At the time the Prince of Jin was attacking Zhenzhou; hence Siyuan seized the opening to strike, took Cheng'an, and then urgently attacked Desheng’s northern city; Jin commander Li Cunshen resisted with utmost strength.

units.zh: 二月，晉王以兵至，思遠收軍而退，復保楊村。
units.en: In the second month the Prince of Jin came up; Siyuan withdrew to Yang village.
units.literal: In the second month the Prince of Jin arrived with troops; Siyuan gathered the army and withdrew, again holding Yang village.

units.zh: 八月，段凝、張朗攻衛州，下之，獲刺史李存儒以獻。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang took Weizhou and sent captive commissioner Li Cunru to court.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning and Zhang Lang attacked Weizhou and took it, capturing military commissioner Li Cunru and presenting him.

units.zh: 戴思遠又下淇門、共城、新鄉等三縣。
units.en: Dai Siyuan also seized Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.
units.literal: Dai Siyuan also took the three counties of Qimen, Gongcheng, and Xinxiang.

units.zh: 自是澶州之西、相州之南，皆為梁有，晉人失軍儲三分之一焉。
units.en: West of Chan and south of Xiang fell to Liang; Jin lost a third of its stores.
units.literal: From this point, everything west of Chan Prefecture and south of Xiang Prefecture belonged to Liang; Jin lost one-third of its military stores.

units.zh: 龍德三年春三月，晉潞州節度留後李繼韜遣使以城歸順。
units.en: In the third month of Longde 3 Li Jiyao of Luzhou offered the city to Liang.
units.literal: In the third month of spring of Longde 3, Jin Luzhou military retention commissioner Li Jiyao sent envoys offering the city in submission.

units.zh: 先是，繼韜父嗣昭為潞州節度使，戰歿於鎮州城下，晉王欲以嗣昭長子繼儔襲父位。
units.en: His father Li Sizhao had held Luzhou and died at Zhenzhou; the Prince of Jin meant to give the post to eldest son Jichou.
units.literal: Earlier, Jiyao’s father Sizhao was Luzhou military commissioner and fell in battle below Zhenzhou city; the Prince of Jin wished to let Sizhao’s eldest son Jichou succeed his father’s post.

units.zh: 繼韜在潞州，即執繼儔囚之，遣使來送款，仍以二幼子為質。
units.en: Jiyao imprisoned Jichou, submitted to Liang, and sent two sons as hostages.
units.literal: Jiyao was at Luzhou; he thereupon seized Jichou and imprisoned him, sent envoys to offer allegiance, and also sent two young sons as hostages.

units.zh: 澤州刺史裴約不從繼韜之謀，帝命董璋為澤州刺史，令將兵攻之。
units.en: Ze prefect Pei Yue refused the plot; Dong Zhang was sent to take Ze by force.
units.literal: Ze prefect Pei Yue did not follow Jiyao’s plot; the Emperor ordered Dong Zhang made Ze prefect and commanded him to lead troops to attack.

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，晉王即唐帝位於魏州，改天祐二十年為同光元年。
units.en: On jisi in the fourth month of summer the Prince of Jin took the Tang throne at Weizhou, renaming Tianyou 20 Tongguang 1.
units.literal: On jisi in the fourth month of summer the Prince of Jin assumed the Tang throne at Weizhou, changing Tianyou 20 to Tongguang 1.

units.zh: 閏月壬寅，唐軍襲鄆州，陷之。
units.en: In the intercalary month on renyin Tang forces stormed Yan Prefecture and captured it.
units.literal: On renyin in the intercalary month Tang troops raided Yan Prefecture and took it.

units.zh: 巡檢使前陳州刺史劉遂嚴，本州都指揮使燕顒奔歸京師，皆斬於都市。
units.en: Inspection commissioner Liu Suoyan, former prefect of Chen, and Yan Yong, the prefecture commander, fled to the capital and were beheaded in the marketplace.
units.literal: Inspection commissioner and former Chen prefect Liu Suoyan and the prefecture commander-in-chief Yan Yong fled to the capital and were both beheaded in the marketplace.

units.zh: 五月，以滑州節度使王彥章為北面行營招討使。
units.en: In the fifth month Wang Yanzhang of Hua became Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.
units.literal: In the fifth month, Huazhou military commissioner Wang Yanzhang was made Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 辛酉，王彥章率舟師自楊村寨浮河而下，斷德勝之浮梁。
units.en: On xinyou Wang Yanzhang sailed from Yang village and severed Desheng’s pontoon bridge.
units.literal: On xinyou, Wang Yanzhang led boat troops from Yang village stockade floating down the river, cutting Desheng’s floating bridge.

units.zh: 攻南城，下之，殺數十人。
units.en: He stormed the south city, took it, and killed dozens.
units.literal: attacked the southern city, took it, and killed several tens of men.

units.zh: 唐帝棄德勝之北城，並軍保楊劉。
units.en: The Tang emperor abandoned Desheng’s north wall and concentrated at Yangliu.
units.literal: The Tang Emperor abandoned Desheng’s northern city and combined the army to hold Yangliu.

units.zh: 己巳，王彥章、段凝圍楊劉城。
units.en: On jisi Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu.
units.literal: On jisi, Wang Yanzhang and Duan Ning besieged Yangliu city.

units.zh: 六月乙亥，唐帝引軍援楊劉，潛軍至博州，築壘於河東岸。
units.en: On yihai in the sixth month the Tang emperor relieved Yangliu while secretly fortifying east of Bozhou.
units.literal: On yihai in the sixth month the Tang Emperor led troops to relieve Yangliu, secretly moving the army to Bozhou and building ramparts on the river’s east bank.

units.zh: 戊子，王彥章、杜晏球率兵急攻博州之新壘，不克，遂退保於鄒口。
units.en: On wuzi Yanzhang and Du Yanqiu failed to storm Bozhou’s new works and fell back to Zou mouth.
units.literal: On wuzi, Wang Yanzhang and Du Yanqiu led troops in urgent attack on Bozhou’s new ramparts, did not take them, then withdrew to hold Zou mouth.

units.zh: 秋七月丁未，唐帝引軍沿河而南。
units.en: On dingwei in the seventh month the Tang emperor led his army south along the river.
units.literal: On dingwei in the seventh month of autumn the Tang Emperor led troops south along the river.

units.zh: 王彥章棄鄒口，復至楊劉。
units.en: Wang Yanzhang left Zou mouth and returned to Yangliu.
units.literal: Wang Yanzhang abandoned Zou mouth and again came to Yangliu.

units.zh: 己未，自楊劉拔營退保楊村寨。
units.en: On jiwei he abandoned Yangliu for Yang village stockade.
units.literal: On jiwei, from Yangliu he pulled camp and withdrew to hold Yang village stockade.

units.zh: 八月，以段凝代王彥章為北面行營招討使。
units.en: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as northern commander.
units.literal: In the eighth month Duan Ning replaced Wang Yanzhang as Northern Campaign Pacification commissioner.

units.zh: 戊子，段凝營於王村，引軍自高陵渡河，復臨河而還。
units.en: On wuzi Duan Ning camped at Wang village, crossed at Gaoling, and maneuvered along the river.
units.literal: On wuzi, Duan Ning encamped at Wang village, led troops from Gaoling to cross the river, and again faced the river returning.

units.zh: 董璋攻澤州，下之。
units.en: Dong Zhang took Ze prefecture.
units.literal: Dong Zhang attacked Ze prefecture and took it.

units.zh: 庚寅，唐帝軍於胡城，先鋒將康延孝率百騎奔於唐，盡泄其軍機。
units.en: On gengyin at Hucheng vanguard Kang Yanxiao defected with a hundred riders and betrayed Liang dispositions.
units.literal: On gengyin the Tang Emperor’s army was at Hucheng; vanguard commander Kang Yanxiao led a hundred horsemen to defect to Tang and fully revealed our military plans.

units.zh: 命滑州節度使王彥章率兵屯守鄆之東境。
units.en: The Emperor sent Wang Yanzhang of Hua to guard Yan’s eastern frontier.
units.literal: The Emperor ordered Huazhou military commissioner Wang Yanzhang to lead troops to garrison Yan’s eastern border.

units.zh: 九月戊辰，彥章以眾渡汶，與唐軍遇於遞防鎮，彥章不利，退保中都。
units.en: On wuchen in the ninth month Yanzhang crossed the Wen, lost at Difang, and retreated to Zhongdu.
units.literal: On wuchen in the ninth month Yanzhang with his host crossed the Wen, met Tang troops at Difang town, was unfavorable, and withdrew to hold Zhongdu.

units.zh: 冬十月辛未朔，日有食之。
units.en: On xinwei, first of the tenth month of winter, the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On xinwei, first day of the tenth month of winter, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 甲戌，唐帝引師襲中都，王彥章兵潰，於是彥章與監軍張漢傑及趙廷隱、劉嗣彬、李知節、唐文通、王山興等皆為唐人所獲。
units.en: On jiaxu the Tang emperor stormed Zhongdu; Yanzhang’s army broke; he, Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, and others were taken.
units.literal: On jiaxu the Tang Emperor led troops to strike Zhongdu; Wang Yanzhang’s army collapsed; thereupon Yanzhang, army supervisor Zhang Hanjie, Zhao Tingyin, Liu Sibin, Li Zhijie, Tang Wentong, Wang Shanxing, and others were all captured by Tang men.

units.zh: 翌日，彥章死於任城。
units.en: The next day Yanzhang was killed at Rencheng.
units.literal: The next day Yanzhang died at Rencheng.

units.zh: 帝聞中都之敗，唐軍長驅將至，遣張漢倫馳驛召段凝於河上；
units.en: Hearing of Zhongdu’s fall and Tang’s advance, the Emperor dispatched Zhang Hanlun to recall Duan Ning from the river;
units.literal: The Emperor heard of Zhongdu’s defeat and that Tang troops were coming at speed; he sent Zhang Hanlun by post relay to summon Duan Ning on the river;

units.zh: 漢倫墜馬傷足，復限水潦，不能進。
units.en: Hanlun fell, injured his foot, and floods blocked him.
units.literal: Hanlun fell from his horse and injured his foot; again limited by floods, he could not advance.

units.zh: 時禁軍尚有四千人，朱圭請以拒唐軍，帝不從，登建國門召開封尹王瓚，謂之曰：「段凝未至，社稷係卿方略。」
units.en: Four thousand guards remained; Zhu Gui begged to fight; the Emperor refused, climbed the Founding Gate, called Wang Zan, and said: "Until Duan Ning comes the realm rests on you."
units.literal: At the time the Imperial Guard still had four thousand men; Zhu Gui asked to use them to resist Tang troops; the Emperor did not follow, ascended the Founding Gate, summoned Kaifeng Intendant Wang Zan, and said to him: "Duan Ning has not arrived—the altars depend on your strategy."

units.zh: 瓚即驅軍民登城為備。
units.en: Wang Zan mobilized troops and civilians onto the walls.
units.literal: Zan at once drove army and people to mount the walls in preparation.

units.zh: 或勸帝西奔洛陽，趙岩曰：「勢已如是，一下此樓，誰心可保。」
units.en: Some urged flight to Luoyang; Zhao Yan said: "Once you leave this tower, who will stand with you?"
units.literal: Some urged the Emperor to flee west to Luoyang; Zhao Yan said: "The situation is already thus—once you descend this tower, whose heart can be assured."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: The Emperor stayed.
units.literal: Thereupon it stopped.

units.zh: 俄報曰：「晉軍過曹州矣！」
units.en: Soon word came: "Jin has passed Caozhou!"
units.literal: Soon a report said: "Jin troops have passed Caozhou!"

units.zh: 帝置傳國寶於臥內，俄失其所在，已為左右所竊迎唐帝矣。
units.en: He laid the seal in his chamber; it vanished—courtiers had stolen it to greet the Tang emperor.
units.literal: The Emperor placed the dynastic seal in the sleeping chamber; soon it lost its place—it had already been stolen by attendants to welcome the Tang Emperor.

units.zh: 帝召控鶴都將皇甫麟，謂之曰：「吾與晉人世仇，不可俟彼刀鋸，卿可盡我命，無令落仇人之手。」
units.en: He called Huangfu Lin of the Crane-Controlled Guard: "Jin is my mortal foe—I will not await their swords; end my life lest I fall captive."
units.literal: The Emperor summoned Crane-Controlled Guard commander Huangfu Lin and said to him: "I and Jin are world-enemies; I cannot wait for their blade and saw—you may exhaust my life, not let it fall into the enemy’s hand."

units.zh: 麟不忍，帝曰：「卿不忍，將賣我耶！」
units.en: Lin hesitated; the Emperor cried: "Will you betray me!"
units.literal: Lin could not bear it; the Emperor said: "You cannot bear it—will you sell me!"

units.zh: 麟舉刀將自剄，帝持之，因相對大慟。
units.en: Lin moved to kill himself; the Emperor seized him and both wept.
units.literal: Lin raised the blade intending to cut his own throat; the Emperor held him, and they faced each other in great wailing.

units.zh: 戊寅夕，麟進刃於建國樓之廊下，帝崩。
units.en: On wuyin at night Huangfu Lin killed the Emperor beneath the Founding Tower.
units.literal: On wuyin evening Lin advanced the blade below the Founding Tower corridor; the Emperor perished.

units.zh: 〈（《五代會要》：末帝年三十六。）〉
units.en: (《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》: The Last Emperor was thirty-six.)〉
units.literal: (《Five Dynasties Institutional Compendium》: The Last Emperor was thirty-six years of age.)〉

units.zh: 麟即時自剄。
units.en: Huangfu Lin then killed himself.
units.literal: Lin at once cut his own throat.

units.zh: 遲明，唐軍攻封丘門，王瓚迎降。
units.en: At dawn Tang forces took Fengqiu Gate; Wang Zan surrendered.
units.literal: At dawn Tang troops attacked Fengqiu Gate; Wang Zan came out to surrender.

units.zh: 唐帝入宮，妃郭氏號泣迎拜。
units.en: The Tang emperor entered the palace; Consort Guo wept and bowed in welcome.
units.literal: The Tang Emperor entered the palace; consort Guo wailed and came forward to bow.

units.zh: 初，許州獻綠毛龜，宮中造室以蓄之，命曰「龜堂」。
units.en: Xu Prefecture had sent a green-haired tortoise; the palace built a "Tortoise Hall" to house it.
units.literal: Earlier, Xu Prefecture presented a green-haired tortoise; within the palace a chamber was built to keep it, named "Tortoise Hall."

units.zh: 帝嘗市珠於市，既而曰：「珠數足矣。」
units.en: The Emperor once bought pearls in the market and said: "There are enough pearls."
units.literal: The Emperor once bought pearls in the market; afterward he said: "The pearl count is enough."

units.zh: 眾皆以為不祥之言。
units.en: All heard it as an ill omen.
units.literal: The crowd all took it as inauspicious speech.

units.zh: 帝末年改名「瑱」字，一十一，十月一八日，
units.en: Late in his reign he took the name Zhen—omen-readers split the graphs into "one-ten-one" and "tenth-month eighteenth,"
units.literal: In the Last Emperor’s final years he changed his name to the character Zhen, "one-ten-one," "tenth month eighteenth day,"

units.zh: 〈（案：此句疑有脫衍，蓋當時傅會者析「王」字為「一十一」，析「真」字為「十月一八」也。
units.en: (This line is corrupt: contemporaries likely read "Wang" as "one-ten-one" and "Zhen" as "tenth-month eighteenth."
units.literal: (Case: This sentence seems to have omissions and additions; probably contemporaries split the character "Wang" into "one-ten-one" and "Zhen" into "tenth-month eighteenth."

units.zh: 《冊府元龜》作或解云「瑱」字，「一十一，十月一八」，知此句「日」字因下文有「日」字而衍，今姑仍其舊。）〉
units.en: The 《Prime Tortoise》 reads "Zhen" the same way; the word "day" may be a duplicate from the next line—we retain the received text.)〉
units.literal: 《Prime Tortoise of the Imperial Archives》 has an alternate reading of the character "Zhen" as "one-ten-one, tenth-month eighteenth," knowing this sentence’s "day" character was added because of a "day" below—now we provisionally keep the old text.)〉

units.zh: 果以一十一年至十月九日亡。
units.en: He did die in his eleventh year on the ninth of the tenth month.
units.literal: Indeed in the eleventh year he perished on the ninth day of the tenth month.

units.zh: 唐帝初入東京，聞帝殂，憮然歎曰：「敵惠敵怨，不在後嗣。
units.en: Entering the Eastern Capital, the Tang emperor learned of the Last Emperor’s death and sighed: "Grudges need not pass to sons.
units.literal: When the Tang Emperor first entered the Eastern Capital and heard the Emperor had died, he sighed in dejection: "Enemy kindness and enemy hatred do not lie in later generations.

units.zh: 朕與梁主十年對壘，恨不生見其面。」
units.en: We fought ten years; I regret never meeting him alive."
units.literal: I and the Liang ruler faced each other in battle ten years, regretting I did not see his face in life."

units.zh: 尋詔河南尹張全義收葬之，其首藏於太社。
units.en: He ordered Zhang Quanyi to bury the body; the head was kept at the Grand Altar.
units.literal: Soon an edict ordered Henan Intendant Zhang Quanyi to collect and bury him; his head was stored at the Grand Altar.

units.zh: 晉天福二年五月，詔太社先藏唐朝罪人首級，許親屬及舊僚收葬。
units.en: In Tianfu 2 of Later Jin, kin and former officials might reclaim Tang heads stored at the Grand Altar.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Tianfu 2 of Jin, an edict said that heads of Tang criminals formerly stored at the Grand Altar might be reclaimed by kin and old subordinates.

units.zh: 時右衛上將軍婁繼英請之，會繼英得罪，乃詔左衛上將軍安崇阮收葬焉。
units.en: Lou Jiying requested the head; when he fell from favor, An Chongruan of the Left Guard was ordered to bury it.
units.literal: At the time Right Guard senior general Lou Jiying requested it; when Jiying fell into guilt, an edict ordered Left Guard senior general An Chongruan to collect and bury it.

units.zh: 史臣曰：末帝仁而無武，明不照奸，上無積德之基可乘，下有弄權之臣為輔，卒使勁敵奄至，大運俄終。
units.en: The historian writes: The Last Emperor was kind but not martial, clear-sighted yet blind to traitors; lacking his forebears’ virtue and served by power-hungry ministers, he fell when a mighty foe swept in.
units.literal: The historiographer says: The Last Emperor was benevolent but without martial prowess, bright yet not illuminating treachery; above there was no base of accumulated virtue to ride upon, below there were ministers who wielded power as helpers—at last a strong enemy suddenly arrived and the great destiny soon ended.

units.zh: 雖天命之有歸，亦人謀之所誤也。
units.en: Heaven decreed the end, but men too chose wrongly.
units.literal: Though Heaven’s mandate had its return, human planning also erred.

units.zh: 惜哉！
units.en: Pity!
units.literal: Alas!
